qa_pairs.question: What important safety warning is given about pressure gauge 2 during operating procedures?
qa_pairs.answer: Never leave high pressure on pressure gauge (2) during the operating procedures - danger of destruction.

qa_pairs.question: What should be checked before operating the discharging and charging station?
qa_pairs.answer: Check condition of the discharging and charging station before operation. Check level and grade of oil in the compressor. Also refer to the operating instructions supplied with the charging station.

qa_pairs.question: What protective equipment is required when working on an air conditioner?
qa_pairs.answer: Wear protective clothing! Absolute cleanliness is required for the performance of work on an air conditioner.

qa_pairs.question: Which valves should be opened first when operating the charging station?
qa_pairs.answer: Open valves (4, 6 and 22). Turn on the pump with switch (12) and discharge the charging station. Close valve (22) and open valves (5 and 23). Discharge the air conditioner.

qa_pairs.question: Where should the red charging hose be connected?
qa_pairs.answer: Connect red charging hose (1) on the high pressure side (thin pipe or drier) of the air conditioner.

qa_pairs.question: What valve should be opened according to the bottom right instruction?
What should be done when filling the charging cylinder with refrigerant?
qa_pairs.answer: Open charging valve (1) and fill the charging cylinder with refrigerant while the air conditioner is still being discharged. Type and amount of refrigerant should be noted.

qa_pairs.question: What components are connected with charging valve 1 according to the upper right image?
qa_pairs.answer: Connect the refrigerant cylinder (2) and charging hose (16) with charging valve (1). Charging valve (1) remains connected until the charging cylinder has been filled.

qa_pairs.question: What must be removed before connecting the charging hoses?
qa_pairs.answer: Remove the protective cap before connecting the charging hoses to both the low pressure and high pressure sides.

qa_pairs.question: What alternative method is mentioned for discharging and charging the air conditioner?
qa_pairs.answer: The air conditioner can also be discharged and charged with only one charging hose (high or low pressure). However, working with a valve core remover and two charging hoses will speed up discharging and charging procedures.

qa_pairs.question: Where can information about the type and amount of refrigerant be found?
qa_pairs.answer: See label in engine compartment for type and amount of refrigerant information.
